newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers Indonesia $100 mln under GSM-102.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers Indonesia $100 mln under GSM-102.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Wednesday authorized $100 million in credit guarantees for sales of U.S. farm goods to Indonesia under the Export Credit Guarantee Program (GSM-102) for fisal year 1997.
USDA said the commodities covered include wheat, oilseeds, protein meals, feed grains, pulses, barley malt, breeder livestock, poultry breeder stock, meat, cotton and rice.
In a separate release, the department also said it authorized a $10 million credit line to Indonesia under the longer-term GSM-103 program in fiscal year 1997 to cover sales of breeder livestock.
